In contrast, the scrotal examination demonstrates classic signs of right testicular torsion: right testicle elevated with horizontal lie, absent right cremasteric reflex, and negative Prehn’s sign (pain elicited on elevation). Scrotal ultrasound with Doppler confirms markedly decreased blood flow to the right testicle — diagnostic of testicular torsion.

**Impression:**  
✅ Acute right testicular torsion  
⚠️ Time-sensitive urologic emergency — risk of testicular infarction increases significantly after 6 hours from onset
